test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

Picasso painted Guernica in 1937.

options.text: Guernica was painting by Picasso in 1937.
Guernica was been painted by Picasso in 1937.
Guernica was paint by Picasso in 1937.
Guernica was painted by Picasso in 1937.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the active sentence "Picasso painted Guernica in 1937", the** subject** is "Picasso", the **verb** is "painted" (simple past tense) and the **object** is "Guernica".
 
• **When transforming **an active sentence to passive, the object of the active sentence (Guernica) becomes the subject of the passive sentence, the verb form changes to the passive form (was painted), and the subject of the active sentence (Picasso) follows "by".

Therefore, the **correct sentence **is:* 'Guernica was painted by Picasso in 1937.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the explanations for the other options:
 
 
• **"Guernica was painting by Picasso in 1937.**" This is incorrect because "painting" is not the past participle form of the verb "paint". The correct past participle is "painted".
 
• **"Guernica was been painted by Picasso in 1937."** This is incorrect because the verb form "was been painted" does not exist in English grammar. The correct form is "was painted".
 
• **"Guernica was paint by Picasso in 1937."** This is incorrect because "paint" is not the past participle form of the verb "paint". The correct past participle is "painted".
